transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. My name is Dr. Smith, I'll be talking with you today. To start, could you tell me what's brought you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I came because my family and some friends keep telling me I’m making too much out of things. They say the bank papers show nothing was taken, but… I know that’s not right.

It’s been over a year, and I’ve been trying to get them to admit they’re hiding my money. They keep using things like bills, fundraisers, even trip plans to kind of cover it up. I don’t want to sound difficult or anything, but I feel like I have to keep asking them and confronting them until they tell the truth.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you didn't seem to hear or see?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t had anything like seeing things that aren’t there, or voices talking to me. At least, not that I’ve noticed. I know what I’m saying probably sounds strange, but it’s not like that. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?

Aside from these beliefs about your family, have you had any periods lasting a week or more where your mood was unusually high, energetic, or irritable, or alternatively very low and depressed, with changes in your sleep or energy?

Um… I don’t really know. I mean, I get upset and tired sometimes, but I think that’s just because of everything going on. I wouldn’t say I’ve had, like, a whole week where I was suddenly really high or not myself.

And being low… I guess I’ve had bad days, but I don’t know if it’s the way you mean. I’m sorry, is that an okay answer? I just haven’t really noticed it like that.
Aside from these concerns about your family and the money, how have things been going for you at work, with friends, or in your daily routine—are you able to keep up with those as usual?

Um… I think I do okay with the regular things. I don’t have a job right now, but I still make my own meals and get myself to the county clinic and my assistance appointments. I keep my things in order, like I always have.

It’s mostly the arguments about the money that make things tense. But day to day, I’m not just… falling apart or anything. Is that what you mean?
Do you have any medical conditions, past head injuries, seizures, or use of alcohol or drugs that I should know about?

Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I don’t have anything big like that to report. I haven’t had seizures or, um, serious head injuries that I know of.

I don’t really use drugs, and alcohol isn’t really something I’m doing. Medical stuff… nothing that I think is important for this. Is that okay? If there’s something specific you mean, I can try to remember.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory, concentration, or ability to think clearly since these beliefs about your family started?

Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I can forget little things like anyone, but I haven’t noticed my memory getting bad or anything.

Concentrating is harder when I’m worried, but I think that’s normal, right? I can still follow what people are saying and handle my appointments. I don’t feel like my thinking is unclear… at least not that I can tell. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
